review_evidence: Mathport/Syntax/AST3.lean and Mathport/Syntax/Translate/*.lean encode and translate Lean syntax and declarations, while Mathport/Binary/*.lean defines binary decoding and expression/name translation machinery.
Mathport/Util/Name.lean defines mapStrings, toFilePath, and String.toName'; Mathport/Util/Parse.lean defines parseNat, parseBool, parseJsonFile, and parseTLeanImports.

Mathport/Util/Misc.lean provides Expr.isAppOfArityGE, InductiveType replacement helpers, Declaration.collectNames, and reusable monadic/container interfaces, so the source is substantive formal/metaprogramming prior art.
summary: Retain mathport because its AST, translation, binary-format, bridge, and utility modules define reusable formal tooling interfaces and semantics; its test sources also contain searchable declarations.
